context: Use the Parquet tables under data/. See metadata.yaml for paths and context/description.md for field descriptions. Hints are optional and selected by the experiment configuration.
query: As of 2023-01-01, among all projects whose most recent report (dated on or before 2023-01-01) records a status of 'completed', which project has the highest accumulated total funding, and what is that funding amount in USD? Accumulated total funding means the sum of all funding amounts granted to that project on or before 2023-01-01.
